## What's new

- **Landscape covers are now automatic.** The automatic SteamGridDB match also downloads the horizontal cover, along with the portrait cover, background, logo and icon. Games that already had artwork get their landscape cover the next time their games load.
- **Game cards use the landscape cover** in Continue Playing and All Games, without a logo on top, because the logo is built into the cover. The Library uses the portrait cover the same way.
- If SteamGridDB has no landscape cover for a game, its card falls back to the background with the logo on top.
- In **Edit Artwork**, the sections are renamed **Landscape Cover** and **Portrait Cover**. Both can still be changed by hand, like any other image.

## Install
Download `Starlight.ipa` below and install it with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) over your current version, using the same Bundle ID.
